headline: Chiefs play falls incomplete
what_happened: P.Mahomes tried to pass to R.Rice, but the ball hit the ground instead of being caught.
who: P.Mahomes threw the pass intended for R.Rice.
why_it_matters: Since this was the third try, this incomplete pass means the Chiefs have to consider punting or taking a big risk on their final fourth try. This makes it harder for the Chiefs to win, dropping their chances by 6 percentage points.
